title: Common providers: Norway
coverage: Complete for the national carriers, the three mobile networks, the main national fibre and business networks and the research network; the many regional fibre companies are partial (two are listed).
missing: Most regional and municipal fibre companies (many sell under the Altibox name)
A website for Sikt (it refused an automated request on the read date)
Status pages for Altibox, Eidsiva and NTE (none answered a check on the read date)

sources.name: Nkom (Norwegian Communications Authority): list of registered providers
sources.terms: No reuse licence was found on the pages read on the read date, so nothing is copied.
sources.result: The page and the first page of its list answered on the read date. It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in Norway and 3 more pages
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names and former names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 7 of 9 entries were found by a name on the 4 pages read.

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 8 of 9 websites and 5 support or status pages answered an automated check; an address that did not answer is left empty.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider or a company the entry names.
sources.result: 10 AS numbers confirmed; a number whose registered holder was an unrelated name was left out.

sources.name: RIPE NCC list of AS names
sources.terms: No licence statement was read: used only to find candidate AS numbers, each then confirmed as above; nothing is copied.
sources.result: Read to find which AS numbers are registered under each provider's company names.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

providers.name: Telenor
providers.notes: Fixed and mobile. AS8786 (Telenor Mobil) is registered to it and was not announced on the read date.

providers.name: Telia
providers.notes: Mobile and cable. AS198309 is the Phonero network. AS12929 (NetCom) and AS41164 (Get) are registered to it and were not announced on the read date.

providers.name: Ice
providers.notes: Mobile network; part of the Lyse group (its own site says so). AS203995 is registered to Lyse Tele AS.

providers.name: Altibox
providers.notes: Fibre sold by regional partner companies under one name. AS29695 is registered to Lyse Tele AS.

providers.name: GlobalConnect
providers.notes: Networks named Broadnet and Ventelo are registered to it.

providers.name: Eidsiva
providers.notes: Regional fibre in inland eastern Norway.

providers.name: Sikt
providers.notes: Research and education network; formerly Uninett.
